Exact crop of the published Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Dark Side), PDF page 28: the slip of [[Kuat Drive Yards (V) (Virtual Block 4) (Errata 3)]] (official text as of 27 April 2013; PDF built February 2014). It prints errata version PC-E3 (“Deploy on table. Unique (•) ''Imperial''-class Star Destroyers draw one battle destiny if not able to otherwise and are immune to attrition < 4. During your deploy phase, may use 2 Force to ▼ a battleground system. We're In Attack Position Now is canceled. [Immune to Alter]”), word for word the text of [[Kuat Drive Yards (V) (Virtual Block 4)]].<ref>[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_DS.pdf|Master List (Dark Side)]]. Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170704232650/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf Internet Archive].</ref>
